source: បច្ចេកទេស ដាំដុះដំណាំដំឡូងជ្វា (Sweet Potato Cultivation Techniques), MAFF General Directorate of Agriculture, 2018
text:
Good care after planting is important for yield. Regular, timely weeding should be combined with periodic mounding/hilling of the ridge. Farmers with adequate water access can irrigate to support vine growth; use of manure or synthetic fertilizer also supports good results. Weeds should be removed by hand-pulling or hoeing on a regular schedule.

Periodically lifting and turning the vines is an important practice: if vines are left undisturbed, they can root down at leaf nodes along the ground, which diverts the plant's resources away from the main tuber(s) and reduces yield at the primary root. Growers are advised to lift/flip the vines periodically through the growing season to prevent this secondary rooting.
